summary: fix(react): fetch only the best locale and en l10n bundles
description:
Because:

* AppLocalizationProvider fetched every regional variant that
  parseAcceptLanguage returns, so en-US loaded en, en-GB and en-CA

This commit:

* Fetches only the best negotiated locale and en, duplicates removed
* Uses the same list for the fetch and the bundle generator

Closes FXA-14861
